input.content: Pattern (P1, mixed-version compatibility): a client increment starts REQUIRING a new response field (e.g. settings-save receipt `applied: True`) that only a pending/undeployed provider task will emit. Against the released provider the check `response.get("field") is not True` fails on every call, even with the feature flag off — and the provider has already committed the write, so the caller sees failure for a successful operation. Unit tests mocked with the new field hide it. Check: when a client adds a response requirement, fetch the released provider source (e.g. git tag) and trace one call; gate strict enforcement on provider capability (field present / negotiated version) or on the disabled-by-default flag, and add a test using the released-provider response shape.
